# `base/copyable`

A value exists to be copied — an id, key, or reference — and needs copy feedback.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A value exists to be copied — an id, key, or reference — and needs copy feedback.
- **Avoid when:** The value is prose, or the copy affordance belongs to a whole block.
- **Consider instead:** `primitives`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Copyable } from "themelia-ui/base/copyable"
import "themelia-ui/base/copyable.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/buttons`, `base/toaster`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"span">, "children" | "onCopy" | "onError">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `value` | yes | `string` | Value written to the clipboard. |
| `displayValue` | no | `ReactNode` | Display content, when it differs from the copied value. |
| `mono` | no | `boolean` | Monospace the display content. For ids, keys, and hashes. |
| `truncate` | no | `boolean` | Truncates the display content at the width the caller allots. |
| `compact` | no | `boolean` | Sizes the trigger to the text rather than a control's height, for values inside a list<br>row. The target keeps its minimum hit area. |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<CopyableStrings>` | Overrides this control's own copy. |
| `silent` | no | `boolean` | Suppresses the toasts. The copied state on the control is the confirmation then. |
| `buttonProps` | no | `Omit<ButtonProps, "children" \| "onClick" \| "type">` |  |
| `onCopy` | no | `(value: string) => void` |  |
| `onError` | no | `(error: unknown) => void` |  |

### `CopyableStrings`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `copy` | yes | `string` | Accessible name for the control before it has been used. |
| `copied` | yes | `string` | Accessible name while the copied state is showing. The name IS the state here. |
| `success` | yes | `string` | Toast raised on success. The component's `silent` prop suppresses toasts. |
| `error` | yes | `string` | Toast raised when the clipboard write is refused — no permission, no secure context. |

### `useCopyToClipboard`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ confirmMs, write, onCopy, onError, }?: UseCopyToClipboardOptions) => UseCopyToClipboardResult
```

### `UseCopyToClipboardOptions`

Kind: interface.

Copy a value, confirm it, and reset — the shared implementation for every copy surface.
The window is keyed off a counter, not a boolean: re-setting `true` is a no-op, so a
second copy would inherit the first one's remaining window.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `confirmMs` | no | `number` | How long the confirmation stands, in ms. Defaults to 2000, Copyable's window. |
| `write` | no | `(value: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | Where the value goes when it is not the platform clipboard — for environments without<br>`navigator.clipboard` (webviews, insecure origins). |
| `onCopy` | no | `(value: string) => void` |  |
| `onError` | no | `(error: unknown) => void` |  |

### `UseCopyToClipboardResult`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `copied` | yes | `boolean` | True from the moment the copy succeeds until the window closes. |
| `copy` | yes | `(value: string) => Promise<boolean>` | Resolves `true` when the value was written, `false` when it was not. |
